snippet.title: Devils Due - The Gambling Roguelike | Early Access
snippet.description:
Steam release: 11.07.25
Itch.io release: 28.07.25

Buy on Itch.io: https://data-illusion-studios.itch.io/devils-due
Wishlist On Steam:  (Available soon) 

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Spin your way through the depths of Hell in this unique slot machine RPG where every pull could be your last!

The Ultimate Slot Machine Experience
Step into a world where slot machines aren't just games of chance—they're your weapon against the forces of darkness. DEVIL'S DUE combines classic slot machine mechanics with deep RPG elements, creating an experience unlike anything you've played before.

Face the Lords of Hell
Every phase of your journey brings you face-to-face with increasingly powerful demonic bosses:

The Debt Warden - A merciless collector who taxes your winnings and heals from your success

The Fortune Ripper - A cunning adversary who twists the very fabric of luck itself

The Right Hand - The Devil's most trusted lieutenant, wielding powers that defy mortal comprehension

Each boss fight is a strategic battle where your slot machine skills directly translate to combat damage. Win big to deal massive damage, but beware—these demons have abilities that can turn your victories against you!

The Lucky Charms System
Collect and master over 40 unique Lucky Charms, each with their own powers and strategies:

Symbol Powers - Boost specific symbols or increase their appearance rates

Tribute Modifiers - Make deals with the Devil to control your debt payments

High-Risk Charms - Russian Roulette offers death or glory, while Glass Cannon trades safety for massive power

Shop Control - Loaded Dice, The Gambler, and Pawn Shop Coupon let you manipulate the shop's offerings

Charm Sets - Combine specific charms for powerful set bonuses

Advanced Gameplay Features
Dynamic Pattern System - Multiple winning patterns with increasing complexity

Phase-Based Progression - Each phase introduces new mechanics and challenges

Economic Strategy - Manage credits, coupons, and interest rates

Spectacular Animations - Watch your winnings fly across the screen with stunning visual effects

Voice-Acted Bosses - Each demon has unique voice lines that react to your performance

Immersive Audio Experience
Dynamic Music System - Multiple tracks that adapt to your gameplay

Atmospheric Sound Effects - Every spin, win, and loss feels impactful

Boss Voice Acting - Each demonic entity has their own personality and taunts

The Price of Failure
In DEVIL'S DUE, failure has real consequences. Run out of credits to pay your tribute, and your soul is forfeit. But victory brings legendary rewards—defeat a boss and claim their unique Legendary Charm, permanently altering your gameplay experience.

Multiple Difficulty Phases
Progress through increasingly challenging phases where:

Phase 1: Learn the basics while facing the Debt Warden

Phase 2: Master advanced strategies against the Fortune Ripper

Phase 3: Survive the ultimate challenge against the Right Hand

Endless Replayability
With procedurally generated charm shops, multiple boss strategies, and countless charm combinations, every run offers a unique experience. Can you find the perfect strategy to defeat all three lords of Hell?

Spin wisely, mortal. The Devil always collects his due.
